svg.title: Everything, out of one part
svg.desc: A whiteboard sketch: a single NAND gate and its four-row truth table, then NOT built by tying a NAND's two inputs together, AND built from two NANDs, OR built from three NANDs by De Morgan and XOR wired out in full from four NANDs, each panel labelled with its gate count and circuit depth, beside a price list of NAND counts and depths for six gates, with a five-gate AND/OR/NOT version of XOR crossed out in red.
svg.text: an AND is just an inverted NAND
De Morgan: a OR b = NOT(NOT
a AND NOT b). Push the
and the OR falls out. That
